title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
author: Douglas Adams
description: A comedic science fiction adventure following Arthur Dent's journey through space after Earth's demolition.
reviewText: An absolute masterpiece of comedic sci-fi. The humor is timeless and the story is endlessly quotable.

title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: A witty romance exploring the relationship between Elizabeth Bennet and the proud Mr. Darcy in Regency-era England.
reviewText: Austen's wit is razor-sharp. The social commentary feels surprisingly relevant even today.

title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
description: A tragic tale of wealth, love, and the American Dream set in the Jazz Age on Long Island.

title: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
description: An epic saga of politics, religion, and ecology on the desert planet Arrakis.
reviewText: The world-building is unparalleled. Herbert created an entire universe that feels alive and breathing.

title: To Kill a Mockingbird
author: Harper Lee
description: A young girl in the Depression-era South witnesses her father defend a Black man accused of a terrible crime.
reviewText: A profound exploration of racial injustice through the innocent eyes of Scout. Essential reading.

author: George Orwell
description: A chilling portrayal of a totalitarian society where Big Brother watches every move and thought.

title: The Hobbit
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: Bilbo Baggins embarks on an unexpected adventure with a company of dwarves to reclaim a lost kingdom.
reviewText: The book that started it all. Tolkien's storytelling is magical and the world he built is extraordinary.

title: Educated
author: Tara Westover
description: A memoir of a woman who grows up in a survivalist family in Idaho and eventually earns a PhD from Cambridge.

title: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
author: George R.R. Martin
description: A compilation of the first three novellas about the adventures of Ser Duncan the Tall and his squire Egg in the world of A Song of Ice and Fire.

title: A Drop of Corruption
author: Robert Jackson Bennett
description: A fantasy novel set in the world of Foundryside, exploring the consequences of corruption and power in a city built on magical industry.

title: Becoming
author: Michelle Obama
description: The former First Lady chronicles her journey from Chicago's South Side to the White House.

title: Project Hail Mary
author: Andy Weir
description: An astronaut wakes up alone on a spacecraft with no memory of how he got there, tasked with saving Earth.
